Recent notes

  • B4C target: why the July B4C night shows no pairs 2026-10-20N_TOFGeant4B4CPairs

    The B4C disc made 1.6 internal pairs per pulse, but at ≤ 11.45 MeV their leptons stop before the plastics: Geant4 expects 0.03 pair events in the whole night. Data inventory, the simulation, and the comparison with ³He.

  • Big trigger plastics: build them ourselves 2026-10-20FacilitiesDetector

    In-house plates €30k vs €82k; thick plates stay uniform; a 2.5 MeV threshold hides soft γ; split-in-two option; per-facility γ follow-up.

  • Scintillator recovery after the γ-flash 2026-10-20N_TOFScintillators

    Quick pass: example and average waveforms of the 44 X17 scintillator channels after the n_TOF flash, and the time each one takes to come back to baseline, split by beam intensity.

  • Demokritos neutron beams for ³He: no 2026-10-19DemokritosFeasibility

    Can the Demokritos neutron beams drive the n_TOF ³He capsule to an X17 measurement? No: ~500 pairs/day at the lab’s flux, and any stronger source makes its own target the experiment.

  • Demokritos ⁴He feasibility 2026-10-19DemokritosFeasibility

    Could the MX17 apparatus test the ATOMKI ⁴He anomaly, ³H(p,e⁺e⁻)⁴He, on the Demokritos tandem with the lab’s own tritium targets? Rates, backing, Geant4 reach.

  • GANIL/NFS X17 feasibility 2026-10-19GanilNfsFeasibility

    Can fast neutrons at GANIL/NFS test the ATOMKI ⁴He anomaly with the MX17 apparatus? Spectrum fold, Geant4 reach, and the beam background from a forced-collision Geant4 run.
